functionalRequirement: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the creation of all specified account types (savings, fixed deposit, etc.) with all necessary attributes and functionalities for 100% of the account types mentioned.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle different account types, necessitating full coverage of these account functionalities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must correctly apply account-specific rules and calculations (e.g., interest rates, withdrawal limits) for each account type with an accuracy of 100%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct handling of different account types and their associated rules.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process account opening requests within 5 seconds for 95% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves account creation, which should be processed quickly to enhance user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear instructions and tooltips for opening different types of accounts, achieving a user satisfaction score of at least 4 out of 5 in usability tests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with the system to open accounts, necessitating ease of learning.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must allow users to open accounts through an intuitive user interface, with a maximum of 3 clicks from the main menu to account creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction for account creation, which should be straightforward and efficient.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process account opening requests for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to account creation services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all account-related data using AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive financial data, which requires strong encryption for protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must implement checksums or digital signatures to ensure the integrity of account data during transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial data that must be protected against unauthorized changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The system must be designed with separate modules for each account type, allowing for independent updates and maintenance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires handling different account types, which should be modular for easier maintenance.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to add expenses with details including amount, date, payer, and optional split among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to input all specified expense details (amount, date, payer, optional split) for 100% of expense entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle all specified expense details, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately calculate and record the split of expenses among participants with an accuracy of 100%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct handling of expense splits.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process expense entries within 2 seconds for 95% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time expense entry, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear instructions and examples for adding expenses, achieving a user satisfaction score of at least 4 out of 5 in usability tests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with the system to add expenses, necessitating ease of learning.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must allow users to add expenses through an intuitive user interface, with a maximum of 3 clicks from the main menu to expense entry.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction for expense entry, which should be straightforward and efficient.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process expense entries for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to expense entry services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all expense data using AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive financial data, which requires strong encryption for protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must implement checksums or digital signatures to ensure the integrity of expense data during transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial data that must be protected against unauthorized changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The system must be designed with separate modules for expense entry and split calculations, allowing for independent updates and maintenance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires handling different aspects of expense entry, which should be modular for easier maintenance.
